description: This PHP class defines the LDAPSyncStatusModel, which serializes LDAP synchronization status data for an API. It uses traits to facilitate normalization and is part of the LDAP API models in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatusModel
classes.description: A model for serializing LDAP synchronization status information, including start and finish timestamps and status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with LDAPSyncStatus entity data, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.
